description: This file is an ECMAScript module for managing and generating plugin SDK facades, including functions for resolving, listing, and building module representations and types for a plugin SDK system. It handles dynamic import generation, export analysis, and TypeScript path resolution, serving as a core part of a plugin architecture.

methods.name: listFacadeEntrySourcePaths
methods.description: Returns a set of unique source paths for an entry, including its main source and additional export sources.

methods.name: buildFacadeSourceModuleKey
methods.description: Builds a string key for source modules based on their index in the source paths array.

methods.name: normalizeFacadeSourceParts
methods.description: Parses and normalizes a source path into directory name and artifact basename, supporting supported patterns.

methods.name: collectRuntimeApiPreExports
methods.description: Reads a specific runtime API file, parses its TypeScript AST, and lists exported names that are relevant for pre-export analysis.

methods.name: resolveFacadeSourceTypescriptPath
methods.description: Resolves the TypeScript path for a given facade source path, checking for existing .ts or .tsx files.

methods.name: resolveFacadeModuleResolutionContext
methods.description: Creates or retrieves cached TypeScript module resolution context, considering tsconfig settings.

methods.name: resolveFacadeSourceExportKinds
methods.description: Analyzes the exports of a facade source file, determining types, functions, callables, and primitive likeness.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkFacadeModule
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for a plugin SDK facade module, including import statements and export proxies, based on an entry specification.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkFacadeTypeMapModule
methods.description: Builds a TypeScript module defining the plugin SDK facade type map, specifying types and source modules.
